author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell shares a striking analogy from an AA speaker about the real difference between faith and trust. Watching a tightrope walker cross safely is faith, believing he'll make it. But climbing into the wheelbarrow and letting him push you across is trust, actually surrendering control. He connects this to what it means to hand your life over to God, not just believing in something from a distance, but being willing to get in the wheelbarrow yourself.

title: Are you faithful or do you actually trust?
